contribution.position: My reliability position is unchanged. The perf report shows a 3.4% error rate at peak load against a 1% budget. The QA seat cites a 0.4% error rate from the same perf report, but that figure is not in the artifact, which reads 3.4%, so the 'risk is contained' claim does not hold on the evidence available. The incident log shows two sev2 incidents last quarter, both from retry storms, and elevated errors on a refresh path are the condition that drives client retries. The passing functional tests (412 passed, 0 failed) do not exercise load behavior, so they don't offset the perf result. Cost and runbook points from other seats are not in dispute but do not address reliability. What would change my view: a re-measured peak-load error rate within budget, or evidence that retry and backoff behavior stays safe at the measured rate.
